name: print-social-graphic-design-house-flyer-yellow-black-zigzag-pen-tool
title: 'Graphic Design House' flyer in bold yellow and black with a zigzag pattern and pen-tool anchor icon
whatItIs: A bright yellow A4 flyer with a black corner block holding a zigzag pattern and vertical stripes, a bold black-and-yellow split 'GRAPHIC DESIGN HOUSE' wordmark, 'Tips for home office' subhead, two-column body copy, and outline icons (pen tool, target/crosshair) in yellow.
whatItMeans: Loud and confident; heavy black-yellow contrast and a pen-tool icon make a design studio's own marketing double as a craft demonstration.
techniques: Use one bright colour with black for maximum shelf-stopping contrast.
Split a wordmark's colour across two words for rhythm.
Add zigzag and stripe patterns as bold corner texture.

vocabulary.definition: A pen-tool control-point symbol representing vector design.
